The Central Information Commission (CIC) is the apex appellate authority established under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005 to promote transparency and accountability in public administration.

items: The CIC is a statutory body created under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005.
It functions as the highest (apex) appellate authority regarding transparency and RTI enforcement in public administration.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Central Information Commission (CIC) serves as the apex appellate authority for RTI matters.
It was established under the statutory mandate of the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005.
The primary mandate of the Commission is to promote transparency and accountability in public administration.
